objectives: Describe the tasks of a clerk, a legal assistant, an assistant notary, a substitute and a notary.
List the legal requirements for an assistant notary, a substitute and a notary, with the article for each.
Explain how the competition for notaries and the exam for substitutes work.
Prepare an application for a first job in a notary office.

cards.front: How many assistant notaries may a notary appoint?
What are the requirements for an assistant notary?
cards.back: The requirements for a notary, **regardless of age and experience**: citizenship, law degree, legal capacity, clean criminal record and the others in Art. 8(1) ЗННД (Art. 41(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What does an assistant notary add to the signature?
cards.back: "помощник" (Art. 40(2) ЗННД). A substitute adds "по заместване" (Art. 46(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: An assistant notary makes a mistake that costs a client money. Who pays?
cards.back: The notary, **jointly** with the assistant (Art. 40(3) ЗННД). The notary's insurance covers the faults of the assistant (Art. 30(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: An assistant with two years of legal experience asks to be entered as a substitute. What follows?
cards.back: Refusal: a substitute needs **three years** of legal experience under Art. 8(1) item 3 and an **exam** for the first term (Art. 46(1), (3) ЗННД).

cards.front: Maximum term of a substitution by an assistant notary?
cards.back: **Two years** from the entry in the register (Art. 46(2) ЗННД).

cards.front: When is the exam for substitutes held, and what form does it have?
cards.back: Twice a year, in **April** and **October**. It is **oral**, with one theoretical and one practical ticket. Pass mark: good (4) (Ordinance No. 2 of 2003).

cards.front: A 62-year-old lawyer wants to apply for a notary place. When is that possible?
cards.back: Only when the term of the competition is extended for lack of candidates (Art. 11(5) ЗННД). The normal limit is **60 years** (Art. 8(1)).

cards.front: How many notary places does a district have?
cards.back: At least **two**; one place for every **10,000 inhabitants** (Art. 10(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What are the parts of the competition for notaries?
cards.back: A **written** exam (3 hours, anonymous) and an **oral** exam. Grade at least 4 in each; ranking by the average (Ordinance No. 36).

cards.front: What must the notary office have?
cards.back: **Two or more functionally connected rooms** with the chancery and the archive; only one office in the district (Art. 13 ЗННД).

cards.front: A notary is elected municipal councillor. May the notary keep practising?
cards.back: **No.** The post of a councillor is incompatible with the profession (Art. 9(1) ЗННД), and an incompatibility is a ground for loss of capacity (Art. 35 ЗННД).

quiz.question: A law graduate with legal capacity and no work experience wants to become an assistant notary. Is that possible?
options: Yes; age and experience are not required for an assistant
No; three years of legal experience are always required
No; an assistant notary must be at least 30 years old
Only after the graduate passes the competition for notaries
quiz.explanation: Art. 41(1) ЗННД: the assistant must meet the requirements for a notary regardless of age and experience. Three years of experience and an exam are needed only to act as a substitute (Art. 46(1)).

quiz.question: Which act may an assistant notary NOT perform, even on the instructions of the notary?
options: A deed for a mortgage on a flat
Certification of a signature
Certification of a copy of a deed
Service of a notarial invitation
quiz.explanation: Art. 40(1) item 4 ЗННД excludes the deeds that create or delete mortgages; items 1 to 3 exclude real-estate deeds, acts recognising ownership and wills. Signatures, copies and invitations stay within the assistant's powers.

quiz.question: What makes an assistant notary able to act alone while the notary is on holiday?
options: Entry as a substitute, after three years of experience and an exam
A written authorisation from the notary, filed in the case book of the office
A permission of the president of the district court
Nothing; an assistant always acts alone when the notary is away
quiz.explanation: Art. 46(1) ЗННД: an assistant replaces the notary only when entered as a substitute, which needs the experience of Art. 8(1) item 3 and an exam for the first term (Art. 46(3)). A letter from the notary gives no such power.

quiz.question: An assistant was entered as a substitute on 1 March 2025. On 15 June 2027 the notary is still abroad. May the assistant act as substitute?
options: No; the term ended on 1 March 2027, two years from the entry
Yes; the term runs until the notary comes back to the office from abroad
Yes; a term of substitution lasts three years from the entry
Yes, if the notary extends the term with a written letter
quiz.explanation: Art. 46(2) ЗННД: a term of substitution may not exceed two years from the entry in the register. After that the notary and the assistant file a new application; a letter cannot extend the term.

quiz.question: What may candidates use at the exam for substitutes?
options: Legal acts and case law on paper
A laptop with a legal database
Their own handwritten notes
No aids of any kind at all
quiz.explanation: Art. 3(3) of Ordinance No. 2 of 2003 allows normative acts and case law on paper only; any other aid means removal from the exam.

quiz.question: What is the minimum grade to pass the written exam of the competition for notaries and go to the oral exam?
options: Good (4)
Average (3)
Very good (5)
Excellent (6)
quiz.explanation: Art. 9(1) of Ordinance No. 36: only candidates with at least good (4) in the written exam go to the oral exam. The ranking then uses the average of the two grades, each at least 4 (Art. 10(5)).

quiz.question: A district has 45,000 inhabitants. How many notary places does the general rule give?
options: Four
Two
Five
Three
quiz.explanation: Art. 10(1) ЗННД: one place for every 10,000 inhabitants, and at least two in every district. 45,000 inhabitants hold four full tens of thousands; the course reads the rule without rounding up. The Minister may open more places on a proposal of the Council of Notaries (Art. 10(4)).

quiz.question: A notary applies to appoint an assistant notary. Which documents for the entry does the Council of Notaries need from the assistant?
options: The order, the declaration, the insurance and the specimen signature
All the documents of Art. 14(2), including the document of ownership of the office
Only the order of the Minister and the signed oath sheet
The order and a certificate of three years of legal experience
quiz.explanation: Art. 14(3) ЗННД: for an assistant notary only items 1, 2, 5 and 7 of Art. 14(2) apply: the order, the declaration, the insurance and the specimen signature. The office documents concern the notary, and experience is not required (Art. 41(1)).

quiz.question: Which activity is compatible with the work of a notary?
options: Teaching law as a freelance lecturer, without an employment contract
Working as a lawyer in a law firm, without an employment contract with it
Sitting as a municipal councillor in the town of the office
Managing a small commercial company owned by the family
quiz.explanation: Art. 9(1) ЗННД lists the incompatible activities: a post in a state or municipal body, an employment contract, practising as a lawyer, trade and the management of companies. Freelance teaching is not in the list.

quiz.question: Which of these is a condition for the entry of a new notary in the register?
options: Two or more connected rooms for the office
A bank guarantee of 100,000 euro
At least two employees with legal training
A recommendation of the district court
quiz.explanation: Art. 13(2) ЗННД requires two or more functionally connected rooms for the chancery and the archive; Art. 14(2) adds the insurance, the seal and signature specimens and the document of the office. No guarantee, staff or recommendation is required.

quiz.question: What secrecy duty does a newly hired clerk have?
options: The same as the notary
None until the end of the probation period
Only for real estate deeds
Only towards the press
quiz.explanation: Art. 49 ЗННД: employees keep the official secret under the conditions set for the notary, from the first day and towards everybody, not only the press.

quiz.question: Who trains the employees of a notary office?
options: The notary, who must introduce, train and guide them
The Notary Chamber alone, through its seminars
The Ministry of Justice, through its inspectors and inspections
Nobody; the training of staff is voluntary
quiz.explanation: Art. 34(2) ЗННД puts the duty on the notary. The Council of Notaries also organises training (Art. 65(1)), but that does not replace the notary's duty.
